segments.name: Biopharmaceutical
segments.description: A biopharmaceutical company that discovers, develops and commercializes medicines through nimble subsidiaries called Vants, for patients with unmet needs.
segments.evidence: The Company's chief operating decision maker views the operations and manages the business in a single operating and reportable segment focused on the discovery, development and commercialization of medicines and technologies.
